description: Set the absolute quantity for a card + board in a deck (not a delta). A quantity of 0 removes the row. Use add_deck_card to increment instead. Requires IWMM_API_KEY.

cardId.description: Internal IWMM card UUID. Get from search_cards or get_card.

deckId.description: Deck id. Get from list_decks or create_deck.

isSideboard.description: Which board the row belongs to. Mainboard and sideboard are separate rows.

quantity.description: Absolute quantity to set. 0 removes the row.

name: set_deck_card_quantity
